name: ARA swap arbitrary approved-source authorization failure
summary: The ARA swap helper let any caller name the source account whose allowance it spent with transferFrom. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker forced an approving EOA to sell ARA, pumped ARA on Pancake V3, forced the same EOA to buy ARA back at the inflated price, and dumped its ARA for USDT.
notes: The constructor fixed the Pancake V3 router and ARA/USDT pool; the runtime has no setter that changes the arbitrary-source behaviour.

Victim set: allowance-granting EOA 0xb817ef68 plus the Pancake V3 ARA/USDT pool, whose combined ARA is unchanged while USDT leaves; USDT at par. Two copycat flash-loan contracts forced the same EOA through the swap 16 minutes later, taking 6,498.34 and 225.33 USDT.
